name: Store Portal Auth & Forgot Password Recovery Flow

planSteps.description: Navigate to the store root portal URL without table parameter to view the staff portal landing page
Store Portal Landing card is visible with store logo, title 'เข้าสู่ระบบร้านค้า' (Store Staff Portal), and email/password inputs
A 'ลืมรหัสผ่าน?' (Forgot Password?) link is clearly visible next to the Password label
Click on the 'ลืมรหัสผ่าน?' (Forgot Password?) button
The portal switches to 'ขอรีเซ็ตรหัสผ่าน' (Reset Password) mode with an email input field and 'ส่งลิงก์รีเซ็ตรหัสผ่าน' (Send Reset Link) button
Enter registered email 'staff@cafeorder.com' and click 'ส่งลิงก์รีเซ็ตรหัสผ่าน' (Send Reset Link)
A green success alert banner appears confirming that the password reset link has been dispatched to the email inbox
Click '← กลับไปหน้าเข้าสู่ระบบ' (Back to Sign In)
The portal returns to the sign-in form with both email and password fields restored
Click on '🧑‍🍳 ทดลองเข้าจอครัว (Demo Staff)' button at the bottom of the portal card
Kitchen Display System (KDS) loads successfully showing active orders and navigation bar
